architecture_decisions: Update publication identity contract to introduce a server-owned helper with specific requirements.
Implement exact durable replay and preserve exact durable delivery records for existing lineages.
Establish branch identity for publication and ensure replacement lineages do not collide with existing branches.
Ensure exact same-run accepted lineages receive distinct deterministic branches in the same run.
Improve publication identity contract to include branch identity derivation and replay.
work_items: Update source-delivery and greenfield-delivery test suites to account for changes.
Update test fixtures to include the new branch helper and exact same-run replacement-lineage.
Update architecture.md and PROJECT-CONSTITUTION.md to reflect changes.
Update DESIGN-SYSTEM.md and PROJECT-CONSTITUTION.md to reflect changes.
validations: Update VerifyLineageDelivery and GreenfieldVerifiedLineageDelivery to use the new branch helper.
Update PREVIEW and REVIEW contracts to account for changes.
Update PREVIEWS and REVIEW contracts to reflect changes.
Update architecture.md and CURRENT-STATE.md to reflect changes.

AC-01: validate protected requirement — For a valid Project/run and exact `src:<sha256>` lineage, the helper returns exactly `parallax/{project8}-{run8}-{lineage16}` and returns the same value on replay.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — Two different exact accepted `src:<sha256>` lineages in the same Project/run produce different deterministic branch names while retaining the same Project/run prefix.
AC-03: validate protected requirement — Missing, non-string, non-`src:` or non-64-hex accepted lineage identity is rejected before provider branch mutation.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — `VerifiedLineageDelivery` and `GreenfieldVerifiedLineageDelivery` both call the same server-owned branch helper; no duplicate greenfield-only or benchmark-specific branch derivation exists.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — If an exact durable delivery record exists for the full accepted lineage, delivery returns that record before provider mutation and does not require branch recreation.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — If the computed lineage-scoped branch already exists without the exact durable delivery record/read-back identity, provider conflict remains a hard failure; no reuse, suffixing, force update, deletion, or history rewrite occurs.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Publishing a replacement lineage in the same Engineering Run creates a new branch/commit/PR/Preview and does not mutate or close the earlier lineage branch, commit, PR, or Preview.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — P2-V0.23.42 true-empty, canonical-baseline, commit-bearing-empty, non-empty-drift and concurrent-ref protections are unchanged; only post-verification feature-branch identity changes.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Tests and diff prove no new provider permission, credential, repository scope, network, command, model, execution profile, source authority, force-ref, delete, merge, production, or automatic REVIEW authority.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — The exact spec passes deterministic validation plus authentic DSPy SpecCritic/SpecCompiler and strict committed-plan validation before semantic implementation. Focused regressions, full applicable API regression, Bounded Autonomy, Workstream Spec Validation and P2 CI pass on the exact reviewed head.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — The exact merged API source reaches Vercel production READY with normal preflights, `/health` and `/ready` HTTP 200, and reviewed exact-deployment runtime scans. Frozen W9-S1 run `a64d56b7-ad42-42ad-9562-891783363f4a` remains at human `REVIEW` revision 12 and republishes replacement lineage `src:001736ab731e243956cf78ede7a0087d2b81595f1008568850eac1e9acc3e809` without `GREENFIELD_BASELINE_MISMATCH` or `BRANCH_CONFLICT`.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — Production acceptance proves the replacement lineage receives a distinct bounded branch, exact lineage commit, GitHub PR and READY Vercel Preview while the earlier W9-S1 branch/PR #1 remain unchanged and the Engineering Run remains at human REVIEW revision 12.

No changes to automatic merge or production promotion.
